reason: V3 contains contradictory visible dimensions and excessive model-annotation import; cosmetic rearrangement is not acceptable.
method_basis: Manual of Engineering Drawing: dimension for manufacture/function, datum-based control, true/basic position for patterns.
Mechanical Tolerance Stackup and Analysis: functional dimensioning, worst-case chains, interface/assembly shift and GD&T relationships.
implementation_sequence: 1. Use Gate04E P006 as the pilot because it is geometrically simple and its service feature is newly controlled.
2. Create one native SOLIDWORKS first-angle drawing from a controlled DRWDOT template.
3. Import only model dimensions explicitly marked for drawing from selected named features; never the entire model.
4. Add true native hole callout for the two service holes and datum/GD&T only where function requires them.
5. Run semantic QA: every displayed dimension must map to exactly one Drawing Definition characteristic; no contradictory duplicates.
6. Once the pilot is accepted, apply the same compiler to P003 and P007.
next_gate: Gate04E P006 candidate must exist before the native P006 drawing pilot can be generated.
